0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Brooklyn Nets in the Pelicans' 12th game of the season, sitting at 4-7 overall with a 3-3 home record, a 4-6 mark over their last ten, and a three-game losing streak, which leaves them 12th in the West and 5 games back in the Southwest. New Orleans is without Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (illness), with Nolan Traore day-to-day and a game-time decision due to calf soreness. The Nets enter at 2-8, 13th in the East and 6.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a two-game losing streak, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 with no games played yet in 2026-27, most recently meeting on January 14, 2026, when New Orleans won 116-113 in New Orleans.
